name: Information Processing Engineer Examination - Information Security Specialist Examination
name_ja: 情報処理安全確保支援士試験 (SC)

logistics.format: National statutory paper exam, twice yearly (April / October)

recommended_certs.rationale: SEA/J CSBM のセキュリティ運用管理知識は、IPA 情報処理安全確保支援士 (SC) の午前II〜午後の管理系設問の前提知識と重複範囲が広い。
TLS / 鍵管理 / セキュア実装といった CSPM 技術コースの内容は、SC 午後 I/II の技術系出題に直結する定番ルート。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Recorded national recognition and consistent professional hints support professional security knowledge despite open eligibility; passing the exam alone does not establish registration, experience or senior leadership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The substantial national specialist exam and recorded IPA/METI professional hints support professional security knowledge. Zero experience and no specified practical component mean passing does not prove professional case delivery or expert leadership.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded specialist examination and consistent IPA and METI professional hints support substantial security knowledge. Open entry and the paper format limit proof of execution, so I do not infer expert practical ability.
